source: A fully dynamic usage, such as {0}, has no static part. No check can follow it. The {1} check, off by default, lists such usages. To mark keys as used that only code at runtime builds, add globs to {2}. Or mark them in the code with a comment. {3} before a string marks that string as a key. {4} before an expression, such as an array, marks every string in it:
